QuestInfo.name: [Mushroom Castle] Welcome, Valued Customer
QuestInfo.0: Violetta is trying to convince the Prime Minister to get treatment, but he is still refusing. What now?
QuestInfo.1: The Prime Minister finally decided to get treatment, thanks to Violetta's persistence. You'll need the Mushroom All Cure Potion to treat his disease. It's very rare, but luckily the potion seller has just one left in stock.
QuestInfo.2: You purchased the Mushroom All Cure Potion from the potion seller for the Prime Minister. He was cured completely when he took a sip of the medicine, and then the contest could proceed as planned.

0.msg: #face1#Dear Violetta, please forgive your father. My foolish resentment and vengeance has landed us here. I'm so sorry, but I truly do love you.

1.msg: Father, please accept treatment. I'm sorry but I cannot lose my father after this! I will never forgive you if you leave me again!

2.msg: #face1#Violetta... You're right. I can't leave you in this harsh world. #h0#, I know I have no right to do so, but can I ask you something? I want to live. Please find me a cure. This is my last wish.

yes.0: #face1#The only way to cure this illness is the #r#t4034113##k. It won't be easy to get. They're usually found at the ends of the world.
yes.1: #face1#But how convenient it is that the #bPotion Seller#k has an All Cure Potion! You just have to buy it for me. Easy, right?

no.0: #face1#I know that you went through so much hardship because of me. But friends are forever. This is my last request.

1.0: Oh, hero! Thank you for getting the potion! With this, we can save my father!

0.msg: At first I was overcome with resentment toward my father, but I only wish to save him now! Please help!

npc.0: #face1#I'm a pretty lucky guy. The #r#t4034113t##k is very rare and the #bPotion Seller#k just happens to have one.
